department: Chemical & Biomedical Engineering, FAMU-FSU College of Engineering

deadline.value: The 15 January date for full departmental funding consideration appears without a year.
deadline.quote: For full consideration for departmental funding, please complete the application by 15 January

gre_general.value: The GRE is recommended with percentile minima, not required; the decision uses the full application.
gre_general.quote: A recommended Graduate Record Examination General Test (GRE) score of a minimum GRE percentile of at least 48% on the verbal portion and 75% on the quantitative portion of the test

supervisor.value: The page does not say whether a faculty supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: All current PhD students are supported by assistantships; funding is limited and priority goes to doctoral applicants.
funding.quote: all current PhD students are supported by these assistantships

entry_route.value: The PhD accepts an undergraduate or a graduate GPA of 3.0 or higher.
entry_route.quote: An undergraduate upper-division or graduate GPA of 3.0 (on a 4.0 scale) or higher

notes: One admissions block covers the PhD in Chemical Engineering and the PhD in Biomedical Engineering, so bme is listed in also_fields. Prerequisite courses may apply to non-majors.
